profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Keller Postman | Building Robust Web Applications
profile.summary:
I design and build scalable, user-centered software solutions that support Keller Postman’s mission to deliver innovative, tech-enabled legal services. With over four years of experience in full-stack development, I specialize in backend systems using C# and Python, while also delivering responsive, intuitive frontends with JavaScript and React.

Certified through Flatiron School, I’m passionate about writing clean, maintainable code, collaborating across teams, and constantly learning new ways to solve real-world problems with technology.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Front-End Development · Back-End Web Development · Python (Programming Language) · PostgreSQL · React.js · Azure DevOps Services · TypeScript · Microsoft Azure · C#

positions.title: Patient Care Nurse Assistant
positions.description:
Reliable, service-focused nursing professional with excellent patient-care and charting skills gained through two years of experience as a PCNA. Compassionate and technically skilled in attending to patients in diverse healthcare settings. BLS and CPR certified.

Nursing Skills
•Patient Care & Safety
•Diagnostic Testing
•Medical Terminology
•Electronic Medical Records
•Vital Signs & Patient Monitoring
•Medication Administration
•Privacy / HIPAA Regulations
•Patient Advocacy and Support

positions.title: Home Health Aide
positions.description:
This job consisted of
•Caring for mentally handicapped individuals 
•Documents and observes patients’ behavior
•Administers oral medications
•Assists patients with therapy exercises as supervised by Physical Therapists
•Performs housekeeping tasks like changing bed sheets, cleaning room and bathroom and vacuuming
•Assists patients in moving in and out of bed, bathing, dressing, grooming and restroom daily routine.
•Provides companionship and emotional support to patients
